candidates.change_summary: Change the final returned value from true to false.
Return success of the last external call instead of true (propagate last call's boolean result).
Return logical AND of all external call results instead of true (aggregate call success flags and return their conjunction).
Change the encoded selector to call transfer(address,address,uint256) instead of transferFrom, altering which external function is invoked on caddress and thus observable behavior.
Change the call to use delegatecall instead of call, causing the invoked code to run in this contract's context and changing post-call observable state.
Remove the requirement that the external call succeeds (drop require(_s)), so failed calls no longer revert and can change observable behavior.
Swap the order of arguments in the encoded selector for the call to pass _tos[i] then from, changing which addresses are used by the callee and thus observable outcomes.
